bullets.text: In Gummidipoondi, a casual worker died and two others fell critically ill after inhaling toxic gas while transferring chemicals between containers.
Vanathi Srinivasan criticized the government regarding Pallikaranai wetland, noting future generations will not forgive damage to Chennai's natural flood defense.
The Pallikaranai wetland buffer zone has been reduced to an interim 316.76 acres after a review by the Tamil Nadu State Wetlands Authority.
In Pallikaranai, an IT worker was kidnapped in an auto and robbed of money and his cellphone by attackers.
The National Green Tribunal directed Avadi Corporation to stop solid waste and contamination from spilling into the Cooum river.
Avadi police arrested three people who cheated victims out of six crore rupees through a fake online trading advertisement.
Police arrested two people at the Ponpadi checkpost and seized twelve kilograms of gutka smuggled from Andhra Pradesh.
The CapitaLand Data Centre was opened at the Ambattur SIDCO Industrial Estate with leaders present for the launch event.
Union Minister Jitin Prasada stated that India's new data centre policy is in the works to prevent consumer power shortages.
Jio Platforms is set to launch India's biggest initial public offering next week to raise thirty thousand two hundred thirteen crore rupees.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched a three thousand one hundred eight crore rupee ring main pipeline project to interlink Chennai water sources.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Chennai to inaugurate and dedicate the fourteen point five kilometer metro rail service between Poonamallee and Vadapalani.
